verdict.rationale: Zep is a SaaS context and memory platform with a dashboard, so an in-product AI assistant is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never documents a built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The Memory MCP Server lets external MCP clients reach Zep memory, and Zep generates thread summaries itself, but both are adjacent features, not an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
